What we do

Focused support.
Clear next steps.

From a difficult interface to a new implementation, we bring focused technical support to your team.

01 /

Interface troubleshooting

Investigate missing results, rejected messages, mapping errors and unreliable connectivity. We work with your team and system vendors to identify causes and support corrective action. Depending on scope, deliverables include investigation findings, recommended corrections and documented retest results.

02 /

Laboratory and device integration

Support diagnostic-instrument and application connections with LIS/LIMS, from requirements and interface mapping through configuration, testing and handover. Depending on scope, deliverables include interface specifications, mapping documents, test records and technical handover guidance.

03 /

Implementation support

Additional technical capacity for healthcare vendors and consulting teams. Support for customer discovery, requirements, vendor coordination, issue resolution, testing and go-live. Responsibilities and deliverables are agreed around your project milestones and delivery needs.

Scope, access, responsibilities and authorised changes are agreed before work begins.
